main.description: Annotation of a sub-string within a host record's text. Holds a byte range and one or more semantic features describing what the range means.

mention.description: Facet feature for a mention of an atproto account by DID. The visible handle in the host record's text is informational; the DID is the canonical reference and survives handle migrations.

link.description: Facet feature for any non-AT URI link (https://, mailto:, etc.). For AT URIs, prefer atLink instead so the lexicon validator and the PDS enforce strict at-uri syntax at write time.

atLink.description: Facet feature for a link to an atproto record (at:// URI). The authority should be normalised to DID form at write time so handle migrations don't break the reference.

byteSlice.description: The sub-string range a facet is active for. Indices are UTF-8 byte offsets into the host record's text; byteStart is inclusive, byteEnd is exclusive.
